food_description: Nendran banana chips, 2 mm, fried in coconut oil at 160 C; initial moisture 2.6 % d.b., aw 0.16, PV 1.65 meq/kg
endpoint: moisture % d.b., aw, PV and overall acceptability (9-point) at 120 d
source: Manikantan et al. 2012, J Food Sci Technol, Storage stability of banana chips in polypropylene based nanocomposite packaging films
quality_notes: WVTR/OTR test conditions not stated (films conditioned 28 C/60% RH); pack area assumes both faces of a 15x10 cm pouch; day-120 values read via an automated reader of the academia.edu copy (Tables 2, 3, 7, 9; means of n=3); cross-checked against the paper's text (B, C, D, control aw > 0.60; N 5.3 % and M 9.3 % moisture; D PV 18.4 max; E and N OA 6.6) - check against the published PDF; moisture and aw are not monotonic across films (e.g. L 8.7 % at aw 0.57, C 8.1 % at aw 0.69), so measurement noise is large
